text: Director Hidetaka Miyazaki has stated in interviews (including with IGN) that Nightreign and Elden Ring share the same history up through the Shattering, after which the timelines diverge.
In the Japanese version, the Primordial Night Lord's name is Namaras, meaning 'nameless.'
In the English version, the Night Lord's name Heolstor is an Old English word meaning darkness or concealment, referring to what he became rather than who he was.
The word 'cutting' in the Cutting-Gifted Tribe's name is a horticultural term (confirmed by the Japanese word 'sashiki'), referring to plant propagation rather than violence.
Cut content from version 1.0 of Nightreign mentions a literal golden branch bestowed upon the Recluse, drawing her to Limveld.
The Recluse's backstory and research into Limveld-like phenomena is elaborated further in the Forsaken Hollows DLC content.
